verdict.rationale: Google Cloud ships multiple official MCP servers—Cloud Run's documented MCP server for operating on Cloud Run resources, a separate Cloud Run deployment MCP server, and the googleapis/genai-toolbox MCP server for connecting AI agents/IDEs to databases—explicitly designed to let MCP clients (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) connect to Google Cloud resources. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of these servers' reliability/completeness and a single unified 'official' MCP entry point rather than several product-specific servers.
